name: DeckShep
description:
DeckShep brings local coding-agent controls to your 15-key Stream Deck MK.2 on macOS. Select an agent in Rex or Herdr App and see its chat, folder and reported state. Navigate with Next, Page, Collapse and Attention.

Includes separate Rex and Herdr App profiles. Rex provides Model, Effort and other contextual controls when the provider and verified terminal capabilities support them. Herdr App provides navigation only; its agent input controls are planned for a later release. Pane focus requests require separate opt-in and a verified Herdr signature. Herdr TUI remains an experimental source build.

Requires macOS 13 or later, Stream Deck 6.6 or later, a 15-key Stream Deck MK.2, Rex or Herdr App, and your own Codex CLI or Claude Code account. Provider subscriptions and model usage are separate. Apple silicon is the initial launch target; Intel execution remains unverified.

Independent software by Everett Kotler; no vendor endorsement is implied. AI assistance was used in development, artwork and listing preparation.
